content: अति {%ind.%} [अत्-इ] .²1 A prefix used with adjectives and adverbs, meaning ‘very’, ‘too’, ‘exceedingly’, ‘excessively’, ‘very much’, and showing उत्कर्ष; Surpassing, superior अत्याश्रमानयं सर्वान् <ls>Mb. 12. 12. 6</ls>. नातिदूरे not very far from; ˚कृश very lean; ˚भृशम् very much; also with verbs or verbal forms; ˚सिक्तमेव भवता <ls>Sk.</ls>; स्वभावो ह्यतिरिच्यते <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (With verbs) Over, beyond; अति-इ go beyond, overstep; so ˚क्रम् ˚चर्, ˚वह् <ab>&c.</ab> In this case अति is regarded as a preposition उपसर्ग. .²3 .³({%a%}) (With nouns or pronouns) Beyond, past, surpassing, superior to, eminent, respectable, distinguished, higher, above, (used with <ab>acc.</ab> as a कर्मप्रवचनीय, or as first member of <ab>Bah.</ab> or <ab>Tat. comp.</ab> ज्याशब्दस्तावुभौ शब्दावति रामस्य शुश्रुवे <ls>Rām. 6. 75. 37</ls> in which last case it has usually the sense of eminence or higher degree; अतिगो, ˚गार्ग्यः = प्रशस्ता गौः, शोभनो गार्ग्यः; ˚राजन् an excellent king; or the sense of अतिक्रान्त must be understood with the latter member which will then stand in the accusative case; अतिमर्त्यः = मर्त्यमतिकान्तः; ˚मालः, अतिक्रान्तो मालाम्; so अतिकाय, ˚केशर, <ab>q. v.</ab>); अत्यादित्यं हुतवहमुखे संभृतं तद्धि तेजः <ls>Me. 1. 45</ls>. Surpassing the sun. अति देवान् कृष्णः <ls>Sk.</ls>; मानुषानतिगन्धर्वान् सर्वान्गन्धर्व लक्षये <ls>Mb.</ls>; ˚मानुषं कर्म a deed which is beyond human power, <ab>i. e.</ab> a superhuman action; ˚कशः past the whip (as a horse), unmanageable; ˚त्यद् surpassing that; ˚त्वाम्, ˚त्वान् him or them that surpasses or surpass thee, so ˚मां, ˚यूयं <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) (With nouns derived from roots) Extravagant, exaggerated, inordinate, excessive, extraordinary; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} ˚आदरः excessive regard; ˚आशा extravagant hope; so ˚भयं, ˚तृष्णा, ˚आनन्दः <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab>; अतिदानाद् बलिर्बद्धो नष्टो मानात्सुयोधनः . विनष्टो रावणो लौल्यादति सर्वत्र वर्जयेत् .. <ab>cf.</ab> ‘extremes are ever bad’. .³({%c%}) Unfit, idle, improper, in the sense of असंप्रति or क्षेप ‘censure’; अतिनिद्रम् = निद्रा सम्प्रति न युज्यते <ls>Sk.</ls> The गणरत्नमहोदधि gives the following senses of अतिः:-- विक्रमातिक्रमाबुद्धिभृशार्थातिशयेष्वति {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} अतिरथः रथाधिकं विक्रमवान्; ˚मतिः बुद्धपतिक्रमः; ˚गहनं बुद्धेरविषयः; ˚तप्तं भृशतप्तं; ˚वेगः अतिशयितो वेगः. <ab>Cf.</ab> also प्रकर्षे लङ्घनेऽप्यति <ls>Nm.</ls>
